categories.name: 3-Way Match, Invoice Recorded After Goods Receipt
categories.description: The item follows a 3-way matching control regime where the invoice is recorded after the goods receipt is completed. Advances the softgoal of preserving value-matching control integrity and maximizes working-capital efficiency, measured against Indicator 17 (Time to clearance, 3-way after GR).
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to the declared alternative id=5 in the goal model, representing the standard post-GR invoice recording path frequently observed in variants such as V0001 and V0002.

categories.name: 3-Way Match, Invoice Recorded Before Goods Receipt
categories.description: The item follows a 3-way matching control regime where the invoice is recorded prior to the goods receipt. Helps maximize working-capital efficiency and helps preserve control integrity, measured against Indicator 18 (Time to clearance, 3-way before GR).
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to the declared alternative id=6 in the goal model, representing variants where invoice processing precedes goods receipt as supported by narrative sequences in the sample.

categories.name: 2-Way Match (No Goods Receipt Required)
categories.description: The item follows a 2-way matching regime where goods receipt is bypassed or not required. Helps minimize procurement and matching overhead while slightly impacting value-matching control integrity, measured against Indicator 19 (Time to clearance, 2-way match).
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to the declared alternative id=7 in the goal model, representing simplified workflows that do not mandate goods receipt.

categories.name: Resolve via Consignment Consumption
categories.description: The item is resolved and cleared through consignment consumption tracking. Helps minimize procurement overhead, measured against clearance times and indicator performance.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to the declared alternative id=13 in the goal model, corresponding to consignment-based resolution paths.
